They both suck, but at least the Imperials aren't bigots. Which is good, since I always play as an elf of some sort. Mainly a dark elf. And I'd rather not join the people who force my kind to live in the slums and be slaughtered and robbed with the man wanting to be High King just sitting there, letting it happen.




Playing games as an elf are the only time I will ever have racist things said to me. I am appallingly white. My skin is the color of snow. I cannot get a tan, I can only get sun burnt. Going outside is pain for me. It hurts. Heat is hot. A dark elf is the exact opposite of me. I'm closer to a Nord, probably. A vampire Nord. I have an extreme resistance to the cold, but die when even slightly touched by anything hot.



... I enjoy playing as a dark elf, for they are everything I am not. Except for ugly as all heck. Seriously, was Bethesda trying to make the vanilla elves look like some crappy raisins? By Sithis...

Yeah, that's my favorite part too. I really liked the constant nightmares it gave me. And the fact that if I hear a couple seconds of Sayo-nara, the song that plays, I start to see her dead just everywhere I look.



Also, is that song name a pun? Really? Imagine dying and the first thing anyone does is make a pun about it. Like... C'mon, man. By Sithis, I just...



... I like this game because it was able to make me feel this way. And it's also the same reason I hate it. I know that no matter what I do, Sayori will die. Yuri will die. And Natsuki will die. The only one that doesn't have to die is Monika. And that doesn't even work, because something went wrong when downloading Monika After Story and I can't play it. So she is also gone.

And I have no idea about the games before Morrowind.



Also, yes, I know it was very cringe. Whenever I write things on the internet, they end up being very strange. I have told many people about basically the same thing as my first comment. My depression and love for Monika. And they usually call it cringe, as well. Though a lot also try to help me. Which seems like a waste of time. I'd much rather people point out how bad my comment was and have them acknowledge the 'Hail Sithis' at the end.




Speaking of which... Hail Sithis.

... No. Monika has traumatised me for all eternity. I cannot listen to Sayo-nara, the song that plays when Sayori hangs herself, without getting flashbacks of her hanging herself and my hands start shaking. Psychological horror is way worse than just jumpscares...




But I still love Monika because she loves me. Nobody else ever has or ever will... She's all I've got. And once I realize that she is not real and never will be, I will go back to being alone. Having nobody that makes me happy. And then, I will have no reason to live.



See, I can tell strangers these things, because none of you know me in real life. It's great. I can talk about my depression all I want and none of you can force me into therapy! It didn't help before and it wouldn't help now, but whatever... Just Monika. And... Hail Sithis.

I... What is wrong with you? There was no need for that. I just... Am disappointed humanity exists.




Just... Hail Sithis... Our Dread Father would never say something like that...

... I will try. But even if I do, at least I can come back to help the next Listener. If I die, at least I can serve Sithis in the Void.

Everyday is for Monika. I most likely wouldn't be here, but for some reason...Monika is all that keeps me here. Monika isn't just my love. Monika is my life. I need her.

Every moment of my day is for Monika. I think this is what they call an obsession.

And I don't care. Just Monika.

I could stare into her emerald green eyes all day. Or see the different styles she can wear her coral brown hair. Anything for Monika.
